svg.title: Two VMs: real-time replication before / after

cc:Work.dc:title: Two VMs: real-time replication before / after
cc:Work.dc:description: 100k measured writes, c1/P1; three rounds/mode. Throughput accepted only with final marker + ONLINE checks. Visibility: separate 1,000 serial probes/round, 1ms polling. Old eBPF failed 3/3; no valid replicated throughput.

g.text: Two VMs: real-time replication before / after
100k measured writes, c1/P1; three rounds/mode. Throughput accepted only with final marker + ONLINE checks.
Visibility: separate 1,000 serial probes/round, 1ms polling. Old eBPF failed 3/3; no valid replicated throughput.
